title: How are you today?
lead: One minute, four questions. Your answers help you and your doctor see how you're doing over time.
sleepQ: How did you sleep last night?
measureHint: Optional. Only if you have a machine at home or checked at a pharmacy.
notePlaceholder: e.g. started new medicine, skipped breakfast
needFeeling: Please choose how you feel today.
saveError: We couldn't save that. Please try again.
savedOffline: Saved on this phone. It will reach your records when you're back online.

done.title: You've checked your health today
done.streakStart: Your streak starts today. Come back tomorrow to keep it going.
done.streakKeep: Come back tomorrow to keep it going.

urgent.title: Please get help now
urgent.bpVeryHigh: Your blood pressure reading is very high (180/110 or more).
urgent.sugarLow: Your blood sugar is low (under 70). Take something sweet now, like juice or 3 teaspoons of sugar in water.
urgent.sugarVeryHigh: Your blood sugar is very high (300 or more).
urgent.body: If you feel faint, confused, or the pain is strong, call 112 now. Otherwise, speak to a doctor today.

advice.bpHigh: Your blood pressure is higher than ideal. Sit quietly for 5 minutes and measure again. If it stays at 140/90 or above, book a doctor.
advice.bpLow: Low blood pressure with dizziness: sit or lie down, drink water, and stand up slowly.
advice.sugarHigh: Your blood sugar is high. Drink water, avoid sweet drinks today, and speak to a doctor if it stays high.
advice.fever: For a fever, rest and drink plenty of water. If it lasts more than 2 days, or you have malaria signs, see a doctor.
advice.unwell3: You've felt unwell for 3 days in a row. It's a good idea to speak to a doctor.
